userStories.title: Redact known provider key formats
acceptanceCriteria: Anthropic, OpenAI, AWS, GitHub PAT, and JWT-shaped tokens are replaced with [REDACTED]
Each provider regex is covered by at least one unit test with a representative key
userStories.notes: praxis/redactor.py exposes redact_secrets(text) and PLACEHOLDER='[REDACTED]'. Patterns: _ANTHROPIC, _OPENAI, _AWS_ACCESS_KEY, _GITHUB_PAT, _JWT (composed in _PROVIDER_PATTERNS). Future stories should reuse PLACEHOLDER and extend _PROVIDER_PATTERNS rather than introducing a parallel constant.

userStories.title: Redact generic secret-like substrings
acceptanceCriteria: Any sequence of >= 20 alnum/`_`/`-` characters appearing after the literals key, token, secret, or password (case-insensitive) is replaced with [REDACTED]
Plain English text containing those words but no high-entropy tail is left unchanged

userStories.title: Redaction is idempotent
acceptanceCriteria: Running the redactor twice on the same input produces the same output as one run
Already-redacted [REDACTED] markers are not duplicated or split
